title: Z4 — positional morphology (MI between label position and label form)

definitions.P2: thirds of the ring: floor(3 * idx_in_ring / ring_size), capped at 2
definitions.F1: first glyph unit of the label locus (all its words concatenated)
definitions.F2: last glyph unit of the label locus
definitions.null_P1: permute rank within sign (label moves whole: f1,f2 together)
definitions.null_P2: permute index within ring (label moves whole)
definitions.debiased_effect: observed MI minus null-mean MI (small-sample MI bias)
definitions.chi2: Pearson chi-square of the same rank-block contingency table, permutation null (prefix inventory = F1, suffix inventory = F2)

ambiguities_resolved: A1 thirds of every ring including short ones (>=6 restriction only as sensitivity)
A2 multi-word label treated as one concatenated sequence
A3 two-sided p = deviation from null mean in either direction
A4 Bonferroni family = 6 (4 MI + 2 chi-square), not 4
A5 gate evaluated on TEST signs only
A6 f1 and f2 of one label permute together
A7 primary comma_split=True; comma_split=False reported as sensitivity
A8 primary glyph-unit level; raw EVA level as registered robustness

gate.stratum: ZL3b-n, TEST signs, glyph-unit level, comma_split=True
gate.rule: any of the 6 statistics with two-sided permutation p < 0.01/6 = 0.001667
